provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Dominion rulebook (Rio Grande Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player takes 7 Coppers; remaining Copper, all Silver and all Gold in faceup Supply piles
Each player takes 3 Estates; {n} each of Estate, Duchy and Province in the Supply; box the rest
{n} Curse cards in the Supply; box the rest
Trash card to mark the trash pile
Choose 10 Kingdom cards (e.g. draw 10 Randomizers or a suggested set); 10 of each in faceup piles
Kingdom Victory piles (e.g. Gardens) use {n} cards
Optional: Randomizers as placeholders under each pile; box unused Kingdom cards
Shuffle your 7 Coppers + 3 Estates facedown as your deck
Game ends when the Provinces run out or any 3 Supply piles are empty
Ties go to the player with fewer turns
Random starting player (next game: left of the last winner); play is clockwise
